after_reasons: Model requires 256 MB RAM but device has 128 MB available.

flips.description: Recalculation changed the leading tier from on device to far edge. Changed input(s): device_available_ram_mb. The set of feasible tiers and/or their exclusions changed. Previous latency/cost figures were withheld because they may be stale. Rankings remain provisional; this is a hypothetical scenario, not a deployment action.

limitations: Discrete hypothetical samples, not an exhaustive search or exact switching thresholds.
A one-field change can be insufficient even when a two-field combination could change the winner.
Workload changes may invalidate old cost and end-to-end latency evidence; resupply fresh scenario metrics for numerical comparisons.
Suitability scores use the current uncalibrated engine and are not deployment guarantees.
